import re
# Pour chaque dosage : moyenne oui (codes 1 à 6) et non (code 0) de Age_of_onsets.
# On classe par écart oui - non, avec n par groupe, et on n'imprime que 10 lignes.
clin = ["Patient_ID","Chip_Type","Age","Gender","Blood_Month_sample","French_Residence_Department","French_Region","Rural_or_urban_area","Sensitization","Treatment_of_rhinitis","Treatment_of_athsma","Age_of_onsets","Skin_Symptoms","General_cofactors","Treatment_of_atopic_dematitis"]
dosages = [c for c in tableau.columns if c not in clin]
res = []
for m in dosages:
    out = calculer(operation="moyenne", colonne=m, filtre="", colonne2="", par="Age_of_onsets dans 1,2,3,4,5,6")
    if out.startswith("ABSTENTION"):
        continue
    mo = re.search(r"oui : Moyenne de .*? : (-?\d+\.?\d*) \(calculée sur (\d+)", out)
    mn = re.search(r"non : Moyenne de .*? : (-?\d+\.?\d*) \(calculée sur (\d+)", out)
    if mo and mn:
        vo, no = float(mo.group(1)), int(mo.group(2))
        vn, nn = float(mn.group(1)), int(mn.group(2))
        res.append((vo - vn, m, vo, no, vn, nn))
res.sort(reverse=True)
print("Dosages évalués :", len(res), "sur", len(dosages))
for r in res[:10]:
    print(f"{r[1]} | oui={r[2]} (n={r[3]}) ; non={r[4]} (n={r[5]}) ; écart={round(r[0],4)}")
